scope: Configuration-only Quickwit flat-schema runtime study, 100k full runs and 10k screens; local file storage. Query latencies in correctness audits are not query-performance measurements.

selection.criterion: Lowest mean raw-to-searchable wall time across two uninstrumented full-scale repetitions; CPU is tie breaker. Instrumented follow-up is not an independent holdout.

memory_ownership.reason: Not reprofiled for each configuration. RSS/PSS are shared process snapshots and peaks are not additive.

deduplicated_lifecycle_files.definition: Same filesystem, deduplicated across node and index roots by retained inode inventory.

http_boundary.definition: First request start to last acknowledgement; includes chemistry/backpressure, not network capacity.

shutdown_observation.limit: Last live sample only; up to one second before exit, not an exact process-exit boundary.
